## RestServer.addOpenApiSpecEndpoint() method

Add a new non-controller endpoint hosting a form of the OpenAPI spec.

**Signature:**

```typescript
addOpenApiSpecEndpoint(path: string, form: OpenApiSpecForm, router?: express.Router): void;
```
